description:
The owner removes a member; anyone leaves with member_id "me". A removed member's next
    spend comes from their own balance, never the pool. The owner leaving with members is 409
    team_has_members; alone it ends the team and returns the pool. Needs admin. Free. Same as
    DELETE /v1/team/members/{member_id}.

member_id.description: a member_id from get_team, or "me" to leave
member_id.title: Member Id

name: remove_team_member
